items.question: What does Awaited<T> do and how is it implemented?
items.answer: Recursively unwraps Promise and thenable layers to fulfilled type. Built with conditional types and infer on then callback parameter. Awaited<Promise<Promise<string>>> is string. Non-Promise T unchanged. Compile-time only — runtime still needs await.
items.sixtySeconds: Recursive infer unwrap. null preserved. Pair ReturnType on async fn. Runtime await required.

items.question: What is the return type of async function that returns number?
items.answer: Promise<number> always — async wrapper implicit. Annotate explicitly or let inference. Returning Promise<number> from async is double-wrap — usually return number directly. Caller awaits to get number.
items.sixtySeconds: async always Promise. return 42 becomes Promise 42. Avoid return Promise unless intentional.

items.question: Type a fetch client method so consumers get Session not Promise<Session> after await.
items.answer: async getSession(id: string): Promise<Session> — caller await gets Session. For generic utilities use Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getSession>> in cache type. ReturnType alone is Promise<Session> — need Awaited for unwrapped.
items.sixtySeconds: async returns Promise T. await unwraps runtime. Awaited unwraps type level. ReturnType plus Awaited pattern.

items.question: How do you type AbortSignal on shared fetch wrapper?
items.answer: options?: { signal?: AbortSignal } in wrapper params. Pass through to fetch second argument. Optional so sync tests omit. Link CancellationToken concept in C# — AbortSignal per-operation in JS.
items.sixtySeconds: signal optional on fetch options. propagate to all requests. abort on timeout shutdown.

items.question: Compare TypeScript Promise<T> to C# Task<T> at runtime.
items.answer: Promise<T> annotation erases — runtime is JS Promise object. Task<T> is real CLR type with status exception cancellation. TypeScript types describe intent; C# types survive in IL. Both use await syntax. Scheduling differs — microtasks vs thread pool.
items.sixtySeconds: TS Promise T compile only. C# Task T runtime type. await syntax shared. different schedulers.
